metadata.description: Wire format for `vibe registry publish --json` into a `monorepo` or `localdir` registry (PROP-002 `#registry-type`): where the version directory went and what happened to it. Source of truth for `crates/vibe-wire/src/generated/registry_layout_publish_report.rs`.
`monorepo`: the repository url (credentials redacted) and branch; `localdir`: the registry directory.
`monorepo`: a non-fast-forward rejection was absorbed by one refetch and retry. Always false for `localdir`.
`sha256:` content hash of the published tree — the identity an unchanged re-publish is decided by.
True iff `--dry-run` was passed: the action was decided and nothing was written.
`monorepo`: the pushed commit. Absent when nothing was pushed (`unchanged`, `--dry-run`) and for `localdir`.
The registry type published into. Closed: a reader decides from it whether `commit` and `retried` can carry anything, and a new layout type is a new registry type, announced by a schema change.

`created`: the version directory did not exist and was written; `replaced`: it held different content and `--replace` overwrote it; `unchanged`: it already held identical content and nothing was written. Closed: automation decides from it whether anything changed in the registry.
